description: MCP server for IBM 3270/5250 host terminal automation via PCOMM COM/OLE and EHLLAPI.
name: io.github.trsdn/mcp-server-host

environmentVariables.name: HOSTMCP_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Terminal provider: auto (default), pcomm, ehllapi or fake.

environmentVariables.name: HOSTMCP_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds when waiting for the OIA keyboard lock to clear.

environmentVariables.name: HOSTMCP_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Interval in milliseconds between OIA polls.
